passes.name: P1 composition
passes.goal: Lock the target framing: low grass camera, centered marble, horizon, rough foreground grass, ruin/rock silhouettes, placeholder water ceiling, and placeholder sun position.
done_when: Marble is centered in the lower foreground.
Horizon occupies the lower third similar to the target.
Grass and ruin silhouettes establish scale.
Water ceiling and sun are placeholders only.
fail_conditions: Marble is not centered near the target position.
Final water, caustics, beams, particles, or postprocessing polish are implemented during P1.

passes.name: P2 terrain / grass / ruins scale
passes.goal: Match target grass density, terrain depth, rock masses, and ruin scale.
done_when: Foreground and midground read like the target world scale.
fail_conditions: World still reads as placeholder silhouettes only.

passes.name: P3 real water ceiling
passes.goal: Replace placeholder ceiling with real rendered water geometry.
done_when: Ceiling reads as dimensional overhead water.
fail_conditions: Ceiling reads as flat color, fog, or poster texture.

passes.name: P4 caustics / ripple detail
passes.goal: Add target-like caustic density, ripple detail, and specular linework.
done_when: Caustic pattern density and variation approaches the target.
fail_conditions: Uniform white line coverage or soft cloud blobs dominate.

passes.name: P5 sun-through-water distortion
passes.goal: Add warm sun source behind water with preserved shape and distortion.
done_when: Sun is warm, centered high, and distorted through water.
fail_conditions: Sun is a flat white blob or plain disc.

passes.name: P6 volumetric beams
passes.goal: Add soft sun-aligned beams that widen downward and fade into mist.
done_when: Beams feel volumetric and connected to the sun.
fail_conditions: Beams look like grey triangles or unrelated overlays.

passes.name: P7 particles / mist
passes.goal: Add beam-aware dust/mist particles with target-like density and depth.
done_when: Particles cluster in beams and mist without glitter/confetti feel.
fail_conditions: Particles are evenly sprinkled or starfield-like.

passes.name: P8 postprocessing / color grade
passes.goal: Tune bloom, tone mapping, vignette, contrast, and final palette.
done_when: Final screenshot matches target mood without white washout.
fail_conditions: Color grade destroys contrast or target palette.
